label: No being is jointly omniscient, omnipotent and wholly good
paraphrase: No being is jointly omniscient, omnipotent and wholly good.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: Supply an actual-world bearer map taking each case IsGod witness to one being in the same Rowe signature that satisfies Omniscient, Omnipotent and WhollyGood together. Combined with NoTheisticBeing on that signature it would yield the stage-one denial.
connection_plan.blocker: The case GodExists only supplies an IsGod bearer. HasClassicalAttributes is a separate field, and the case goodness and intellect predicates do not by definition supply the same-bearer Rowe conjunction. The map and the two versions of the suffering and permission premises still need warrant.
